coder_notes: Three non-randomised ERAS-801 monotherapy cohorts (A: recurrent window-of-opportunity pre-surgery; B: recurrent, closed; C: elderly newly diagnosed), so treatment_setting both. EGFR amplification/mutation plus IDH-wildtype required for entry (eligibility criteria shown for Cohorts A and C; Cohort B criteria listed as closed, title implies EGFR requirement for all). EGFR T790M/exon 20 mutations excluded. FDG PET registered as an intervention, listed as diagnostic agent; FDG uptake/glycolytic index used as a pharmacodynamic imaging endpoint. Apoptotic machinery evaluation also planned in Cohort A (not recorded as separate biomarker).
